# `bars`

Helper: `bars([label, count, pct, tone], ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

Rows: label and count on one line, bar under it (8px, tile track, tone fill).

## Variants

- Tone: success, warning, danger, info (brand when none)

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile, brand-500, success, warning, danger, info, heading (count)

## Do

- Use for one distribution (appointments by status)
- Write the count next to the bar

## Don't

- Do not show a bar without its number

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Rows stacked, gap 12.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Dashboard "Lịch hẹn theo trạng thái"; `pct` 0-100, tone `success warning danger info`
